# Yu OS SDK

> Build Yu OS Apps in Python, Node.js, Go, or Rust. Call the user's configured AI model through Yu OS, or expose App tools to the system Agent via MCP.

- Add `"ai": {}` in `app.json` and declare the matching capability, e.g. `{"verb":"ai.chat"}` under `needs`. Import `chat`, `embed`, `tts`, `stt`, `imagegen`, or `decide`. Each result has `provider`, `model`, `units`, and `output`. Settings selects the model and monthly App AI limit.
- Call `chat(prompt)` for text or pass `images` (`format` and `image_base64`) with an image-capable chat model. Pass schemas in `functions`, validate and run proposals in App code, and return results by call ID in `tool_turns`.
- Handle authorization, exhausted budget, service unavailable, and invalid input using the SDK's typed errors.
- Declare optional GUI model capabilities in `optional_needs`. On `model_permission_required`, show an App-written message and let the user open Settings → Applications.
- The built-in System Agent calls enabled MCP tools declared in the signed `app.json`. Set `schema_version: 2` and bind handlers to `mcp.tools`. Name a tool `<app-id>.<command>` to expose `yu app <app-id> <command>`.
- Read caller identity from the Gateway's call context. Use MCP stdout for protocol messages and stderr for logs.
- Apps get their own data directory. Ordinary signed Apps launched by the owner get a public outbound TCP proxy. The system Open dialog gives a signed GUI read access to the selected file in that window.

## Start

- [Model Quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiaoyu-work/Yu-OS/main/yuos-sdk/QUICKSTART.md): call `ai.chat` in a two-file App, declare permission, and run it.
- [MCP example](https://github.com/xiaoyu-work/Yu-OS/blob/main/docs/app-development.md#quickstart-an-mcp-only-app): expose a tool to the CLI and System Agent.
- [Python](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiaoyu-work/Yu-OS/main/yuos-sdk/python/README.md): `App.from_manifest()`, `@app.tool`, `ai.chat`.
- [Node.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiaoyu-work/Yu-OS/main/yuos-sdk/node/README.md): `mcp.App.fromManifest()`, `app.tool`, `await ai.chat`; pass the MCP `signal`.
- [Go](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiaoyu-work/Yu-OS/main/yuos-sdk/go/README.md): `LoadMCPApp`, `Bind`, `ServeStdio`; pass `MCPCall` to `ChatContext`.
- [Rust](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiaoyu-work/Yu-OS/main/yuos-sdk/rust/README.md): `mcp::App::from_environment`, `Tool`, `serve_stdio`, `ai::chat`.

## Reference

- [App guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiaoyu-work/Yu-OS/main/docs/app-development.md): manifest arguments, permissions, AI consent, and installation.
- [Manifest schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiaoyu-work/Yu-OS/main/yuos-sdk/wire/v1/manifest.schema.json): supported fields and types.
- [SDK reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiaoyu-work/Yu-OS/main/yuos-sdk/REFERENCE.md): compatibility, binding coverage, and releases.
- [Wire v1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiaoyu-work/Yu-OS/main/yuos-sdk/wire/v1/README.md): CLI envelopes, call context, and errors.
